verdict.rationale: The official install path (`/plugin install replica-skill@replica-skill`) installs the whole bundle. The docs do say you can paste any single `SKILL.md` into a chat to run it as a mode, and that you can copy the skill folders into `.claude/skills/`, which allows manual picking. However, the skills are designed to run in order, each reading the previous one's output, which limits standalone use. missing for 10: a documented per-skill install command in the plugin/marketplace flow, explicit guidance on which skills work standalone, independent corroboration.
